binders: A real normed vector space Parameter, a material-parameter field Real -> Parameter, and real endpoints left,right.
hypotheses: The material-parameter field is interval-integrable on [left,right].
conclusions: The explicitly defined parameter-space average satisfies the bundled cell-average specification.
mathematical_definitions: average=(1/(right-left))*integral_left^right materialParameter(x) dx, using real scalar multiplication in Parameter.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For an interval-integrable field valued in any real normed vector space and an ordered nonzero-width cell, the integral divided by the cell width satisfies the stated average specification.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: This is a definitional correctness statement, not an effective-medium law, approximation, error estimate, or physical homogenization theorem.
Only normed real vector-space structure is assumed; no positivity, tensor symmetry, invertibility, or material admissibility property is encoded.
Zero-width and reversed cells are excluded.
